sources.entry: Amethyst - Automatic tiling window manager for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Amethyst is a tiling window manager for macOS, modeled on xmonad, that automatically arranges windows into layouts and controls them with keyboard shortcuts.
summary.what_it_does: Amethyst arranges open windows on macOS into automatic tiled layouts such as Tall, Wide, Column, Row, Two Pane, 3Column, Widescreen-Tall, Fullscreen, Floating, and Binary Space Partitioning, and users can cycle between them. Keyboard shortcuts (default modifiers option+shift and ctrl+option+shift) move focus, swap windows, resize or change the main pane count, toggle floating, and throw windows between Spaces and screens. Windows can be moved to Spaces 1 to 16 and to up to five screens by shortcut. A YAML configuration file in the home directory can override settings made in the GUI. Custom layouts can be written in JavaScript, which the README labels as beta. The app is installed from the releases page or with Homebrew cask and needs Accessibility permission on macOS.
use_cases: tile windows automatically on a Mac
arrange windows side by side on multiple monitors
move windows between macOS Spaces with shortcuts
xmonad-style layouts for a Mac desktop
write custom window layouts in JavaScript
how_to_run: Grant Amethyst permission under Privacy & Security -> Accessibility
Optionally disable 'Automatically rearrange Spaces based on most recent use' in Mission Control
Build locally: run `fastlane` in the repository root
notable: Layouts modeled on xmonad, including BSP, Column, Row, and multiple 3Column variants
Keyboard shortcuts configurable through four modifier combinations (mod1 to mod4)
Optional YAML config file in the home directory that overrides GUI settings
Free software; contributions go to the development branch
caveats: Needs Accessibility API permission to function
Custom JavaScript layouts are marked beta
Spaces auto-rearrange setting should be disabled for predictable keyboard navigation
